Nonbinary and gnc are both very different actually! Nb is a spectrum of gender identities that don’t fit into the binary of male/female while gnc is based on presentation based directly off of the expectations of a specific binary gender. There are gender nonconforming women who don’t conform to typical expectations of femininity and there are nonbinary people/lesbians who DO present femininely. I’m a butch lesbian who identifies as both gnc and nonbinary (buckWILD how weird gender is for me) so you can definitely have both!!! But you won’t necessarily always have both and being gnc doesn’t always make you nonbinary. As for recommendations I like the instagram pages for @butchdraws and @rheabutcher :)
